paper_level_summary_zh: 该文在相关工作中将目标论文列为RFID振动感知的代表性工作，指出其受限于大波长而难以检测小位移。

evidences.evidence_quote: RFID technology [11], [12] naturally has the signal-object association ability, but faces challenges in detecting small displacements because of its large wavelength.
